caption: The drawing consists of a piece of fabric embroidered with various objects and designs in different colored threads, including black, blue, brown, red, and yellow. Along the left vertical side, the name "ANN TINKER" is stitched in black thread in a vertical orientation, and at the bottom, the word "KORTRIGHT" is stitched horizontally. There is a decorative scalloped border along the left and lower edges in blue and brown thread, interspersed with embroidered blue and red flowers and brown vines. The main part of the fabric is divided into two horizontal sections by a blue stitched line. In the upper section, four small animals—two brown and two blue—are stitched along the top. Beneath the animals, there is an image of a couple in period dress stitched in blue, pink, and brown thread, as well as a bust of a woman with dark hair, beige skin, blue and gray garment, and a pink mouth and cheeks. In the lower section, a man dressed in blue, red, and yellow is riding a black and gray horse. Near them, small animals, including a brown lamb and a blue bird, are present. The bottom right features larger, stylized red and blue flowers and leaves, with accompanying brown and blue curving lines. The overall composition includes geometric, floral, animal, and human forms, all rendered with colored embroidery on beige fabric.
title: Coverlet
